name: TransferList
description:
Assign items between two lists: Available and Assigned (permissions, group members). Each
list has a search field, checkboxes with a select-all box, and a count in its header; the
buttons between them move the selected items or all listed items. Disabled items stay put
and say why in a tooltip. Lists are virtualised, so thousands of items cost only the rows
on screen. With `orderable` the assigned list can be reordered by dragging or Alt+↑ / ↓.
In a narrow container the lists stack and the move buttons turn to point down and up.

Keyboard: ↑ ↓ move, Shift extends the selection, Space checks, Ctrl/⌘+A selects all,
Enter moves the selection (or the focused item) to the other list, Esc clears the selection.
signature: ({ items, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, orderable, grouped, searchable, disabled, name, className, labels, locale: localeProp, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: TransferListProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Set a height here (the lists fill it); the default is the `--_h` component token.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be selected or moved.

props.name: grouped
props.description: List items under their `group` headings. Default true. The assigned list keeps its own order when orderable.

props.name: items
props.description: Every item that can be assigned. Values must be unique.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ available: string; assigned: string; search: (list: string) => string; selectAll: (list: string) => string; count: (selected: number, total: number) => string; moveSelected: (list: string) => string; moveAll: (list: string) => string; nothingSelected: string; nothingToMove: (list: string) => string; emptyAvailable: string; emptyAssigned: string; noMatch: (query: string) => string; moved: (count: number, list: string) => string; reordered: (label: string, position: number, total: number) => string; reorderHint: string; reorder: (label: string) => string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording for this instance (list titles, counts), over the language pack and `MessagesProvider`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for search matching and wording. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name: one hidden input per assigned value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the assigned values (in order) after each move or reorder.

props.name: orderable
props.description:
The assigned list's order is meaningful: rows carry a grip to drag them, and Alt+↑ / Alt+↓
moves the focused row. Reordering is off while the list is searched. An orderable list
renders every row; keep it to a few hundred.

props.name: searchable
props.description: A search field above each list. Default true.

props.name: value
props.description: The assigned values, in order. Controlled while defined.
